holidays.2027-12-31: New Year's Eve and New Year's Day (observed)

agency: City of Santa Monica Public Works (Resource Recovery and Recycling)

sources.name: Street Sweeping (Public Works, Resource Recovery and Recycling)

words.rule: Weekly street sweeping: no parking on the day and two hours on the curb's sign; the two sides of a street are usually swept on different days.
words.afterpass: All year · not on City holidays · $73 ticket, no tow
words.dataNotes: The City's street sweeping map data (Santa Monica GIS, updated September 2026, ODC-By) gives every curb its own line, day and hours, written without AM or PM: daytime windows are read from 9 AM to 5 PM as on the signs, and Pico Blvd's three nights a week as 3 to 6 AM. Each curb line was put on the side of the City's street centerline it runs along.
